name: friendly-five
description: A web app for friends to agree on clear bet terms, resolve outcomes, and track settlement. Built for MIT 6.1040.

paragraphs: FriendlyFive is a local web application for two friends to record clear wager terms, resolve the outcome, and track the resulting obligation. It was built for the MIT 6.1040 Fall 2026 P2 Alpha milestone using Bun, TypeScript, MongoDB, Vue, and MIT's sync-engine.

FriendlyFive records obligations but does not process payments or enforce a real-world stake. A designated resolver is optional. When the participants disagree about an outcome, an agreed resolver can make the final decision from the terms both participants accepted.

requirements.text: Account registration, sign-in, session restoration, and sign-out
Successful sign-in creates a 30-minute server-side session and sends its identifier in a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie.
